run_migrate_imports_dry_run: run the migrate_imports script in dry run mode on a directory to preview import changes
run_migrate_imports_execute: run the migrate_imports script with --execute to apply import path replacements across a codebase
run_migrate_imports_single_file: run the migrate_imports script on a single Python or YAML file to update import paths
refactor_replace_strings_in_file: refactor the replace_strings_in_file function to support additional file extensions or replacement patterns
review_mapping: review the import path mapping dictionary to add or remove fairchem module migration entries
